_note: Eberron: Forge of the Artificer backgrounds (17). Fourteen dragonmarked-heir backgrounds grant a Dragonmark feat (defined elsewhere); House Agent gives house ties without a mark, and Archaeologist and Inquisitive grant PHB Origin feats. Each raises 3 ability scores, grants a feat, 2 skills, 1 tool, and an equipment package (or 50 GP). Descriptions are an original paraphrase of flavor; source 'eberron'.

backgrounds.name: Aberrant Heir
equipment: Dagger, Disguise Kit, Costume, Traveler's Clothes, 16 GP
backgrounds.description: Your aberrant dragonmark has made life hard since it manifested. You may have hidden it, drawn suspicion and fear, or faced the hostility of the dragonmarked houses. Some aberrants fall in with the House Tarkanan criminal network; others simply get by on their wits and the power of the mark.

backgrounds.name: Archaeologist
equipment: Cartographer's Tools, Bullseye Lantern, Map, Map or Scroll Case, Shovel, Tent, Traveler's Clothes, 17 GP
backgrounds.description: You have spent your life studying lost cultures, visiting their ruins, decoding their records, and examining their relics. Perhaps you trained at Morgrave University, balancing library study with fieldwork in remote sites. You combine the learning of a historian with the grit of a treasure hunter.

backgrounds.name: House Agent
toolProficiencies: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools
equipment: Artisan's Tools (same as above), Fine Clothes, 20 GP
backgrounds.description: You are tied to a dragonmarked house but have not manifested a mark, whether by birth or as a hired employee. You earn your living doing the house's business, acting as its hands, feet, and eyes in the world, with friends, mentors, and rivals inside and beyond the house.

backgrounds.name: House Cannith Heir
toolProficiencies: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools
equipment: Artisan's Tools (same as above), Crowbar, Fine Clothes, 2 Pouches, 17 GP
backgrounds.description: As a scion of House Cannith, maker of the modern world's wonders, you are expected to add to the house's success through invention, scholarship, business, or diplomacy. Only the deep rift among the three barons vying to lead the house stands in its way.

backgrounds.name: House Deneith Heir
toolProficiencies: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
equipment: Spear, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Gaming Set (same as above), Fine Clothes, Healer's Kit, Quiver, 1 GP
backgrounds.description: An heir of House Deneith, you were trained for combat but taught to value duty, honor, and law. You may have served as a bodyguard, mercenary, or fugitive-hunting marshal, and now you are ready to claim your standing in the mightiest of the houses.

backgrounds.name: House Ghallanda Heir
equipment: Cook's Utensils, Fine Clothes, Iron Pot, Lamp, Oil (5 flasks), Perfume, 26 GP
backgrounds.description: Through House Ghallanda you grew up amid comfort, good drink, and fine food. You might be a charming host or a schemer who exploits bonds of trust. You might adventure to master foreign cuisines, widen your network, or earn enough to open your own inn.

backgrounds.name: House Jorasco Heir
equipment: Herbalism Kit, Fine Clothes, Healer's Kit, 25 GP
backgrounds.description: House Jorasco taught you to fight illness and injury by magic and medicine, in the service of others, and always to be properly paid for it. You might be a kindly healer with no taste for combat, or a dispassionate specialist who knows exactly how to incapacitate a foe.

backgrounds.name: House Kundarak Heir
backgrounds.description: As an heir of House Kundarak, you take pride in your family's work safeguarding the valuables of Khorvaire. Long a leader among the clans of the Mror Holds, the house is known for professionalism, honor, and order, which you may uphold, bend, or rebel against.

backgrounds.name: House Lyrandar Heir
backgrounds.description: As an heir of House Lyrandar, the wind is your ally and the sea and sky your dominion. Ascendant thanks to its new airship technology, the house may have put you to work as a sailor, navigator, shipwright, Raincaller, or airship crew, and now sends you to hunt pirates, seek ruins, or salvage wrecks in the Mournland.

backgrounds.name: House Medani Heir
backgrounds.description: In House Medani your life centers on subterfuge, not committing it but preventing it. You read the world as a web of plots, using instinct to foresee threats to your clients and stop them before they become danger. Blocking the blade is a sellsword's job; making sure it is never drawn is the Medani way.

backgrounds.name: House Orien Heir
equipment: Cartographer's Tools, Fine Clothes, Map, Map or Scroll Case, 18 GP
backgrounds.description: Before the Last War, House Orien's roads and lightning rails were the lifeblood of Galifar; the war cut those arteries. Its couriers still move goods across Khorvaire, and reopening routes through the Mournland is the priority. You might serve by investigating lost couriers, recovering stolen cargo, or troubleshooting the rail.

backgrounds.name: House Phiarlan Heir
backgrounds.description: A child of House Phiarlan, you have known wealth, fame, and beauty but prize knowledge and the power it brings above all. You may pursue it as an artist or performer alert for secrets, or through ties to the house's hidden espionage arm, the Serpentine Table.

backgrounds.name: House Sivis Heir
equipment: Calligrapher's Supplies, Fine Clothes, Ink, 5 Ink Pens, Paper (30 sheets), Parchment (9 sheets), 8 GP
backgrounds.description: For nearly thirty centuries your family has worked to keep order, settling the disputes of sovereigns and helping the houses find their place. Few realize how much House Sivis has shaped the age, playing a long game of quiet influence behind the scenes amid endless intrigue.

backgrounds.name: House Tharashk Heir
toolProficiencies: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
equipment: Gaming Set (same as above), Climber's Kit, Fine Clothes, Hunting Trap, Manacles, 2 GP
backgrounds.description: Heirs of older houses live in luxury, but in House Tharashk you learned self-reliance early. What your young house lacks in resources it makes up for in spirit. You have learned to play the hunter: study your enemies, exploit their weaknesses, and do whatever it takes to win.

backgrounds.name: House Thuranni Heir
toolProficiencies: Choose one kind of Musical Instrument
equipment: Musical Instrument (same as above), Costume, Fine Clothes, 13 GP
backgrounds.description: Given House Thuranni's short history and focus on espionage, its leaders expect you to advance its interests at every turn. Not every heir must spy, but even its most insular artists must follow the political winds and pass along or gather information when asked.

backgrounds.name: House Vadalis Heir
equipment: Herbalism Kit, Fine Clothes, Net, 29 GP
backgrounds.description: You grew up respecting both family and nature. You know the culture of the Five Nations but avoid its games of ambition and status. Attuned to the beauty and power of life, your insight into the natural world lets you see through the lies of city folk, and never let on how much you notice.

backgrounds.name: Inquisitive
equipment: Thieves' Tools, Bullseye Lantern, Crowbar, Oil (10 flasks), Traveler's Clothes, 10 GP
backgrounds.description: Driven by boundless curiosity, you have honed investigation and deduction to explore mysteries, find missing people, recover stolen goods, and expose corruption and crime. You might freelance, work for an inquisitive agency (perhaps licensed by House Medani or Tharashk), report for a broadsheet, or serve a police force.
